The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'like this' after the words अङ्गुली etc.

Terms: ठक्

The affix षच् comes after a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in the word अङ्गुलि when the compound means 'a piece of wood'.

Terms: षच्

In the यजुर्वेद , when the word अङ्गे is followed by अङ्गे , the subsequent short अ is retained, as well as the preceding ए or ओ।

Terms: संहितायाम्

The first syllable of the word preceding मैरेय gets the acute accent (उदात्त) when it denotes the ingredient of the same.

Terms: समास 1st-acute

Whatever will be taught here after up to the end of the 7th अध्याय is consequent upon the अङ्ग (stem).

Terms: Lengthening

The finite verb retains its accent in connection with अङ्ग when used in a friendly assertion.

Terms: Accent

The final syllable of a finite verb used as a threat becomes प्लुत when the word अङ्ग is joined with it and it demands another sentence to complete the conclusion.

Terms: प्लुत
